notes.title: 1.0.6 - quick changes
notes.notes:
The Sisters secret character now unlocks at a combined Ace level of 12, down from 26
The Irolaz secret character now unlocks at a combined Ace level of 18, down from 36

The Rugana/Angelique storyline now unlocks at a combined Ace level of 8, down from Rugana 13.


Some quick changes to content access to open up this stuff for what I hope will be the vast majority of players :]  I definitely think these barriers were erected a little bit too high
